04 / COMMITTEE MEMO

Recommendation: pilot.

NO TRADE AUTHORIZATION

Decision

Use the full sample allocation as a research starting point. Do not allocate client money or adopt the optimizer as policy yet. The 30 point shift between sample windows and the response to a one point VT estimate cut show material estimation risk.

Conditions to adopt

  1. Client approves the SGOV reserve definition and a loss limit tied to education funding.
  2. Committee replaces sample means with reviewed forward return assumptions and documents costs and taxes.
  3. Operations confirms account liquidity, rebalancing rules, and execution controls.

Process rules

01 Fix mandate and constraints before optimizing.
02 Use point in time, adjusted price history; record the window.
03 Stress the binding return estimate and compare windows.
04 Review turnover, taxes, and client loss tolerance before a trade.
NEXT GATE Client risk interview + forward assumptions
METHOD & PROVENANCE

What this model knows.

Saved Yahoo Finance monthly adjusted closes for SGOV, BND, VT, and TIP, September 2021–September 2026. The course workspace preserved raw responses on 20 and 22 October 2026. The app computes simple monthly returns, annualizes arithmetic means and sample covariance, and searches every 5% long only mix. Its selected weights are sample based, not forward forecasts.

The full sample default reproduces the local mandate’s 45% SGOV / 55% VT result. The last 36 months produce 75% SGOV / 25% VT. Dividends are reflected only to the extent captured by the saved adjusted closes. There is no live price feed.
